crossRefs.note: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

translations.web: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
translations.bsb: I cry out to You for help, but You do not answer; when I stand up, You merely look at me.
translations.kjv: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest
translations.asv: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not answer me: I stand up, and thou gazest at me.
